resources.string: The Playground\'s car navigation uses the AMap SDK to plan routes, navigate and search for places. Before using it you need to agree to the AMap Open Platform Privacy Policy; AMap processes location and network information to provide these services. If you don\'t agree, navigation is unavailable and everything else works as usual.
The key can\'t be empty or contain spaces
This doesn\'t look like an AMap Android key (32 letters and digits)
